792-4279-7452--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-7452--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron of Essence trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cauldron of Essence triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7686-8201.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7686-8201.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl as attackers.
The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5900-6458-8160.easyPrerequisites: Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
5900-6458-8160.description:
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Kwia.
When Kwia enters, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.
5900-6458-8160.notes: Alternate adding {G} and {U} each time. Start by adding the opposite of whatever mana you provide for the {G/U} in the cost.

1168-1479-2841-6926.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Vibrant Cityscape.
1168-1479-2841-6926.description:
Fetch a land using Vibrant Cityscape.
When the fetched land enters, Toggo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Toggo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Toggo from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Toggo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

3967-4550-5567-7824--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
3967-4550-5567-7824--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-5641-7818.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Liliana the Faultless triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1594-2811-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Elas il-Kor trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-2811-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

1018-1987-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1018-1987-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1018-1987-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Skullwinder.
When Skullwinder enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2097-5660-6441-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

1368-1849-6006-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-1849-6006-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

803-2034-3490-7665.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
803-2034-3490-7665.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters as a Hero due to Arcane Adaptation, Captain America triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and the Servo.
Animation Module triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the first Animation Module trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1978-3941-7280.description:
Animate Coveted Jewel using Donatello.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Coveted Jewel.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-5231-6786-7028-7148.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Intruder Alarm triggers twice, untapping all creatures.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4067-4823-6281-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures that share a creature type.
4067-4823-6281-7013.description:
Activate White Lotus Tile by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Timeless Witness.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Timeless Witness that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Timeless Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Timeless Witness from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping White Lotus Tile.
Repeat.

5256-6132-6981.description:
Cast Perigee Beckoner for its warp cost by paying {1}{B}.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Perigee Beckoner.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Perigee Beckoner from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Perigee Beckoner enters, it triggers, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.

323-3944-5220-6900.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

141-2292-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2292-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

3497-6867-6869.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-6867-6869.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1399-1606-1671-2957.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Simic Growth Chamber.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

1671-5449-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
1671-5449-5702-6664.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Simic Growth Chamber and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

238-5756-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning up to one legendary creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Havi.
When Havi dies, it triggers, returning Gerrard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Gerrard trigger from step 2, failing to exile it as it is no longer in your graveyard and returning Havi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.

3384-4550-5256-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2034-2866-3689-5705.notablePrerequisites:
One of the artifact creatures must be in your hand while the other is in your graveyard.
You have enough mana to cast the artifact card in your hand.
2034-2866-3689-5705.description:
Cast the artifact creature card in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Glaring Fleshraker's first ability triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Glaring Fleshraker's second ability triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the artifact creature spell, triggering Glaring Fleshraker's second ability, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the artifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the artifact creature dies, it triggers, returning the other artifact creature from your graveyard to your hand.
If needed, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4050-5789.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4050-5789.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Heliod triggers, holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1976-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
1976-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-1409-2528.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Dualcaster Mage.
147-1409-2528.description:
Cast Channel the Suns by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

360-1981-3129-4591-4740.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least fifty.
360-1981-3129-4591-4740.description:
Activate Aetherflux Resevoir by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, creating 100 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
The Soldiers enter the battlefield, triggering Soul Warden 100 times, causing you to gain 100 life.
Repeat.

1185-1912-2226.notablePrerequisites: Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
1185-1912-2226.description:
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Zacama's third ability by paying {W}, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Repeat.

1803-2034-3951-5003.notablePrerequisites:
Nim Deathmantle attached to Éomer.
Kari Zev does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1803-2034-3951-5003.description:
Declare Kari Zev as an attacker.
Kari Zev triggers, creating a legendary 2/1 Ragavan creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ragavan, adding {C}{C}.
When Ragavan dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Éomer, adding {C}{C}.
When Éomer dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Éomer from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat each combat phase.

391-3478-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Blossom Dryad.
391-3478-4222.description:
Activate Dimir Aqueduct by tapping it, adding {U}{B}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Dimir Aqueduct.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Repeat any number of times.
